instruction: Download the two currently open blog pages as PDF files to /home/user/Documents/Blog directory. Keep both tabs open after downloading.

metadata.explanation: Task requires downloading PDFs while keeping both tabs open. The evaluator checks that exactly 2 Chrome tabs remain open AND 2 PDF files exist in /home/user/Documents/Blog directory. Hash suffix a852a89d ensures unique function names.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator verifies BOTH requirements - PDF files downloaded (pdf_count) AND Chrome tabs kept open (tab_count)
Correct getter logic: get_pdf_files_and_tab_count__a852a89d correctly counts PDF files in /home/user/Documents/Blog using 'ls -1 *.pdf | wc -l' and gets Chrome tab count via get_open_tabs_info
Correct metric logic: check_pdf_and_tabs__a852a89d checks both pdf_count==2 (50% score) and tab_count==2 (50% score), providing appropriate partial credit
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected.get('pdf_count') and expected.get('tab_count') - when expected.type='rule', framework returns rules dict directly
Semantically sound: Getter extracts the right state (PDF files in target directory + Chrome tabs), metric compares the right aspects, expected values are correct
Practical feasibility: Getter can access filesystem and Chrome API without needing postconfig, verification will work at runtime
